items.meaning: Host executes pinned compiler and does not forge verifier events or files.
Byte hashing and canonical identity implementation correspond to recorded inputs.
JSON/normalization/generator is a tested boundary; E05 narrows IR trust but does not silently prove raw JSON.
Fresh checking uses the same pinned Lean kernel; E06 independently studies another checker.
Accepted assessments, policy/gate decisions, clocks and condition/action evidence truth are supplied.
Publication operates within the explicitly mediated/cooperating local writer boundary.
OS storage durability and crash recovery require P08 evidence, not graph theorems.
